President Murmu gives assent to Gujarat Uniform Civil Code, state becomes second after Uttarakhand to enact UCC
articles.description: Gujarat has officially enacted the Uniform Civil Code after presidential assent received in October. This new law establishes a unified legal framework for marriage, divorce, and inheritance across all religions. Residents must register marriages and live-in relationships within specified timeframes to avoid penalties. Scheduled Tribes and certain groups are exempt from the provisions included in this law. The specific commencement date will be notified by the state government shortly.

They claim that the electoral process and the right to vote are being undermined.

articles.title: Ayodhya Ram temple staff to undergo 100 per cent police verification, character checks
articles.description: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust decides to conduct 100 percent verification of all staff working at the Ram temple in Ayodhya. The security measures will include police verification, character certificates and detailed family information. The decision will be applicable to all members of the trust. As part of the overhaul of the temple administration, the trust has also stepped up monitoring of staff and improving facilities.

articles.title: Trump Announces Big Military Base In Poland Amid Putin's Nuclear Warning | Watch
articles.description: Donald Trump says the United States is making “great progress” toward establishing a permanent U.S. Army base in Poland, a move that would deepen America’s military footprint on NATO’s eastern flank. Polish President Karol Nawrocki has even floated the possibility of calling the future installation “Fort Trump.”The push comes as tensions around Russia’s Kaliningrad exclave intensify. Moscow has warned NATO that it could use nuclear weapons if the alliance attempted to isolate Kaliningrad, which sits between Poland and Lithuania. Russian President Vladimir Putin has separately said Russia would use all weapons available to defend its territory.
